resources.string: A place for your next game
Sign in to prepare for online play. Local Backgammon is always available without an account.
If this address is eligible, a confirmation email is on its way. Open the link on this device, or confirm your email and return here to sign in.
If an eligible account uses that address, password reset instructions are on their way. Open the latest link on this device.
Your account is ready. Online rooms and matchmaking will arrive in a later milestone.
Online sign-in is not configured for this build. Local Backgammon remains available.
Use 12–128 characters. Additional password requirements from the server also apply.
The email or password could not be verified. Try again or reset your password.
Confirm your email before signing in. Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
Unable to reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
Too many requests. Wait a little before trying again.
This link is invalid, expired, or belongs to another sign-in attempt. Request a new link on this device.
Secure session storage is unavailable. Restart the app and sign in again. Local play is still available.
Unable to complete the request. Please try again.
After confirming your email, sign in to continue.
Signed out on this device. Server session revocation could not be confirmed while offline.
At least 12 characters. Your server may require additional character types.
This recovery session can only change your password. Save a new password or sign out.
Your session needs attention. Reconnect and refresh, or sign out.
